title: Snap-to-vertex / snap-to-edge picking on thick lines
description: Exercises the WebGLRenderer's snap-pick pipeline on `LinesPrimitive` geometry rendered through the quad-expanded thick-line technique. A box wireframe (free-end caps), a closed pentagram polyline (miter joints throughout), and an open 'Z' polyline (mixed joints + free ends) all carry `lineWidth = 6`. Every `mousemove` is routed through `renderer.pick(view, {canvasPos, snapToVertex, snapToEdge, snapRadius})`; vertex snap rasterises each line's endpoints into the snap FBO as 1-pixel POINTS, edge snap rasterises each line as a 1-pixel `gl.LINES` segment along the mathematical centerline. A marker tints itself red on vertex hits and amber on edge hits.
